comment: Strict allow-list for the idle-traffic test (Gate 1). Every entry is provisional until reconciled with docs/network-calls.md. Host wildcards: '*.' = exactly one DNS label, '**.' = any depth.

entries.purpose: Remote Settings: security-critical collections only (add-on blocklist, CRLite / cert revocation, intermediates)

Download of a newer uBlock Origin XPI when the update check finds one (the XPI itself may come from addons.cdn.mozilla.net)
